description: Research an explicitly selected property and identify evidence requirements for a requested property-record service. Returns source observations and service capabilities; does not establish savings, quote a payable fee, inspect payment methods, charge, generate a filing packet or submit a correction. Sandbox checkout uses separate authenticated sandbox tools.

address.description: Explicitly selected property street address or parcel ID. A nonblank address takes precedence over parcel_id.

county_key.description: Exact registered county adapter key, such as hamilton; restricts source lookup to that county.

parcel_id.description: Explicitly selected county parcel ID / PIDN, used when address is absent or blank.

service_type.description: Explicit research route selected from get_microtransactions_catalog. Common aliases: demolished_outbuilding, square_footage_correction, mailing_address_change, commercial_reclassification, certified_tax_ledger. No service is assumed.

name: audit_microtransaction
